newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta composite index reaches new year-high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta composite index reaches new year-high.

text.p: Jakarta's Composite Stock Index reached a new year-high of 631.64 points at 0300 GMT on Tuesday, boosted by some follow-through buying of newly-listed Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) and selective buying of other stocks, brokers said.
The previous year-high was at 631.41 points, which was recorded in intra-day trade on April 23. The index closed on that day at 628.52 points.
